bio: Senior Data Analyst with senior-level expertise delivering actionable business intelligence across healthcare, pharma, and technology sectors. Designed and deployed scalable ETL pipelines and interactive dashboards, cutting manual reporting time by 50% and reducing data errors by 25% for over 60 business users.

Partnered with product and engineering teams to build analytics infrastructure that boosted feature adoption by 15% and enabled self-service analytics. Aiming to apply data-driven insights to accelerate strategic outcomes and operational efficiency.
